title: HERO: Hierarchical Evidential Reasoning Optimization for Radiology Report Generation via Reason-then-Summarize
abstract: arXiv:2601.03321v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have substantially advanced Radiology Report Generation (RRG), yet aligning them through reinforcement learning (RL) remains challenging due to heterogeneous medical supervision. Vanilla Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) assigns uniform credit across the entire generation, leading to segment interference, token dilution, and rationale-diagnosis decoupling, which exacerbates clinical hallucinations. We propose HERO (Hierarchical rationalE Reasoning Optimization), a factorized policy optimization framework that aligns heterogeneous supervision with three optimization granularities. HERO separately optimizes reasoning, diagnosis, and rationale faithfulness through complementary segment-, token-, and completion-level optimization with a heterogeneous reward formulation covering diagnostic accuracy, reasoning quality, and think-answer consistency. Experiments on MIMIC-CXR and IU-Xray

translated_title: HERO：基于“先推理后总结”范式的分层证据推理优化放射报告生成方法
translated_abstract: 多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）已显著推动了放射报告生成（RRG）的发展，但由于医疗监督信号的异质性，通过强化学习（RL）对其进行对齐仍然具有挑战性。原始的组相对策略优化（GRPO）在整个生成过程中分配统一的信用，导致片段间干扰、token级信号稀释以及推理与诊断的脱节，从而加剧了临床幻觉问题。我们提出了HERO（分层理性推理优化），这是一种因子化的策略优化框架，通过三种优化粒度来对齐异质性监督。HERO通过互补的片段级、token级和完整生成级优化，分别优化推理、诊断和推理依据的忠实性，并采用涵盖诊断准确性、推理质量和“思考-答案”一致性的异质性奖励公式。在MIMIC-CXR和IU-Xray数据集上的实验……
tldr: HERO提出了一种因子化策略优化框架，通过片段级、token级和完整生成级三种互补粒度分别优化推理、诊断与依据忠实性，解决了GRPO统一信用分配所导致的临床幻觉问题。
en_tdlr: HERO is a factorized policy optimization framework that separately optimizes reasoning, diagnosis, and rationale faithfulness through complementary segment-, token-, and completion-level granularities, mitigating the clinical hallucinations caused by GRPO's uniform credit assignment in radiology report generation.
